<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"/>
<title>Robust Regression Engine — README</title>
<style>
/* ─── ROOT TOKENS ─────────────────────────────── */
:root{
  --bg:#0d0d1a; --card:#12121f; --card2:#1a1a2e;
  --accent:#a78bfa; --accent2:#34d399; --accent3:#f472b6;
  --gold:#fbbf24; --red:#f87171; --blue:#60a5fa; --orange:#fb923c;
  --text:#e2e8f0; --muted:#94a3b8; --border:rgba(167,139,250,.18);
  --glow:rgba(167,139,250,.35);
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden;}

/* ─── PARTICLES CANVAS ────────────────────────── */
#particles{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.45;}

/* ─── BACK TO TOP ─────────────────────────────── */
#top{position:absolute;top:0;}
.btt{position:fixed;bottom:32px;right:32px;z-index:9999;
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent3));
  color:#fff;font-size:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 0 20px var(--glow);transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s;}
.btt:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.1);box-shadow:0 0 35px var(--glow);}

/* ─── ANIMATED BANNER ─────────────────────────── */
.banner{
  position:relative;z-index:1;
  min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;
  padding:60px 24px 80px;overflow:hidden;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%,rgba(167,139,250,.12) 0%,transparent 50%),
             radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%,rgba(52,211,153,.10) 0%,transparent 50%),
             radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 80%,rgba(244,114,182,.08) 0%,transparent 50%),
             linear-gradient(180deg,#0d0d1a 0%,#0f0b2a 100%);
}

/* Floating animated blobs */
.blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(80px);animation:blobFloat 8s ease-in-out infinite;}
.blob1{width:400px;height:400px;background:rgba(167,139,250,.08);top:-100px;left:-100px;animation-delay:0s;}
.blob2{width:350px;height:350px;background:rgba(52,211,153,.07);bottom:-80px;right:-80px;animation-delay:-3s;}
.blob3{width:300px;height:300px;background:rgba(244,114,182,.06);top:40%;left:60%;animation-delay:-6s;}
@keyframes blobFloat{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1);}50%{transform:translate(30px,-40px) scale(1.08);}}

/* SVG line grid background */
.banner::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(167,139,250,.04) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(167,139,250,.04) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:60px 60px;
}

/* Icon row */
.banner-icon{font-size:80px;margin-bottom:18px;animation:iconPop .8s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) both;}
@keyframes iconPop{from{transform:scale(0) rotate(-20deg);opacity:0;}to{transform:scale(1) rotate(0);opacity:1;}}

/* Glitch title */
.banner-title{
  font-size:clamp(36px,6vw,72px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a78bfa,#34d399,#f472b6,#60a5fa);
  background-size:300% 100%;
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
  animation:gradientSlide 4s linear infinite, titleIn .9s ease both .2s;
}
@keyframes gradientSlide{0%{background-position:0% 50%;}100%{background-position:300% 50%;}}
@keyframes titleIn{from{transform:translateY(40px);opacity:0;}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;}}

.banner-sub{
  font-size:clamp(14px,2vw,20px);color:var(--muted);margin:14px 0 32px;
  font-style:italic;animation:titleIn .9s ease both .4s;
  max-width:700px;line-height:1.6;
}

/* Stat pills row */
.stat-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin:24px 0;animation:titleIn .9s ease both .6s;}
.stat-pill{
  padding:8px 20px;border-radius:30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid var(--border);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);color:var(--text);
  transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;
}
.stat-pill:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 20px var(--glow);}
.stat-pill strong{color:var(--accent2);}

/* Tech badge row */
.badge-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:24px;animation:titleIn .9s ease both .7s;}
.tech-badge{
  padding:6px 14px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;border:1.5px solid;
  transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;
}
.tech-badge:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);}
.tb-py{border-color:#3b82f6;color:#3b82f6;background:rgba(59,130,246,.1);}
.tb-pd{border-color:#f97316;color:#f97316;background:rgba(249,115,22,.1);}
.tb-sk{border-color:#10b981;color:#10b981;background:rgba(16,185,129,.1);}
.tb-np{border-color:#8b5cf6;color:#8b5cf6;background:rgba(139,92,246,.1);}
.tb-mp{border-color:#ec4899;color:#ec4899;background:rgba(236,72,153,.1);}
.tb-jup{border-color:#fbbf24;color:#fbbf24;background:rgba(251,191,36,.1);}
.tb-sns{border-color:#06b6d4;color:#06b6d4;background:rgba(6,182,212,.1);}

/* Social links */
.social-row{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;margin-top:20px;animation:titleIn .9s ease both .8s;}
.soc-btn{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 22px;
  border-radius:30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;
  transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;
}
.soc-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
.soc-gh{background:#24292e;color:#fff;}
.soc-li{background:#0077b5;color:#fff;}
.soc-ig{background:linear-gradient(45deg,#f09433,#e6683c,#dc2743,#cc2366,#bc1888);color:#fff;}

/* Scroll cue */
.scroll-cue{position:absolute;bottom:32px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;animation:bounce 2s infinite;}
@keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}50%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);}}

/* ─── CONTAINER ───────────────────────────────── */
.container{max-width:1140px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px 80px;position:relative;z-index:1;}

/* ─── SECTION ─────────────────────────────────── */
.section{margin-top:72px;}
.section-label{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px;
  color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:10px;
}
.section-title{
  font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;
  border-left:4px solid var(--accent);padding-left:16px;margin-bottom:20px;
}

/* ─── TOC CARD ────────────────────────────────── */
.toc-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;
  padding:32px 36px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(167,139,250,.08);
}
.toc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px 32px;}
.toc-item{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;
  text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  font-size:14px;transition:color .15s,padding-left .15s;
}
.toc-item:hover{color:var(--accent);padding-left:8px;}
.toc-num{
  width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:rgba(167,139,250,.15);color:var(--accent);flex-shrink:0;
}

/* ─── METRIC CARDS ────────────────────────────── */
.cards-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:16px;}
.metric-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;
  padding:24px 20px;text-align:center;
  transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.metric-card::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(167,139,250,.05),transparent);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;
}
.metric-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(167,139,250,.2);}
.metric-card:hover::before{opacity:1;}
.mc-icon{font-size:36px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.mc-val{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent);}
.mc-lbl{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;}

/* ─── TABLE ───────────────────────────────────── */
.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:var(--card);font-size:13.5px;}
thead tr{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(167,139,250,.2),rgba(52,211,153,.15));}
th{padding:14px 16px;text-align:left;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
td{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:var(--text);}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
tr:hover td{background:rgba(167,139,250,.06);}
.tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;}
.tag-green{background:rgba(52,211,153,.15);color:#34d399;}
.tag-blue{background:rgba(96,165,250,.15);color:#60a5fa;}
.tag-red{background:rgba(248,113,113,.15);color:#f87171;}
.tag-purple{background:rgba(167,139,250,.15);color:#a78bfa;}
.tag-gold{background:rgba(251,191,36,.15);color:#fbbf24;}
.tag-orange{background:rgba(251,146,60,.15);color:#fb923c;}
.best-row td{background:rgba(52,211,153,.06)!important;}

/* ─── PIPELINE ────────────────────────────────── */
.pipeline{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0;margin:20px 0;}
.pipe-step{
  background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;
  padding:16px 20px;text-align:center;min-width:120px;
  transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s;
}
.pipe-step:hover{border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-3px);}
.ps-icon{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.ps-num{font-size:10px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;}
.ps-lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);margin-top:4px;}
.pipe-arrow{font-size:22px;color:var(--accent);padding:0 8px;opacity:.7;}

/* ─── CHARTS ──────────────────────────────────── */
.charts-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;}
.chart-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;
  overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s;
}
.chart-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(167,139,250,.15);}
.chart-card.full{grid-column:1/-1;}
.chart-header{
  padding:14px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(167,139,250,.06),transparent);
}
.ch-num{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent3));
  color:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;
}
.ch-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;}
.ch-desc{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto;}
.chart-img{width:100%;display:block;}

/* ─── THEORY CARDS ────────────────────────────── */
.theory-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;}
.theory-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;
  padding:22px;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s;
}
.theory-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--accent);}
.theory-card h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:10px;
  padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;}
.theory-card p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;}

/* ─── GRAFFITI / VISUAL SECTION ───────────────── */
.visual-section{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;
  padding:32px;margin-top:24px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;
}
.visual-section::before{
  content:'ML';position:absolute;top:-20px;right:-10px;
  font-size:180px;font-weight:900;color:rgba(167,139,250,.04);
  font-style:italic;pointer-events:none;
}

/* ─── MODEL PERF VISUAL ───────────────────────── */
.perf-bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
.perf-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
.perf-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;min-width:150px;color:var(--text);}
.perf-track{flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:30px;height:32px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;}
.perf-fill{
  height:100%;border-radius:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;
  padding-left:14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;
  position:relative;transition:width 1.5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
}
.perf-fill::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.15),transparent);
  border-radius:30px;
}
.perf-r2{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;min-width:60px;text-align:right;}

/* ─── AUTHOR ──────────────────────────────────── */
.author-card{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--card2),rgba(167,139,250,.1));
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:24px;padding:40px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.author-avatar{
  width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent3));
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:44px;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(167,139,250,.3),0 0 40px rgba(167,139,250,.2);
  animation:avatarGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes avatarGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(167,139,250,.3),0 0 40px rgba(167,139,250,.2);}
  50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(167,139,250,.15),0 0 60px rgba(167,139,250,.3);}}
.author-info h3{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;}
.author-info p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:16px;}
.contact-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;}
.clink{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:9px 18px;
  border-radius:24px;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;
  transition:transform .2s,opacity .2s;
}
.clink:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);opacity:.9;}
.cl-gh{background:#24292e;color:#fff;}
.cl-li{background:#0077b5;color:#fff;}
.cl-ig{background:linear-gradient(45deg,#f09433,#dc2743,#bc1888);color:#fff;}
.cl-rw{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981,#059669);color:#fff;}

/* ─── SUMMARY BOX ─────────────────────────────── */
.summary-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;}
.sum-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;
  padding:22px;
}
.sum-card h4{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:12px;
  padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;}
.sum-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:13px;}
.sum-val{font-weight:600;color:var(--accent2);}

/* ─── STRUCTURE ───────────────────────────────── */
.file-tree{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);border-radius:14px;padding:24px 28px;
  font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:2;
  border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);
}
.file-tree .dir{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;}
.file-tree .file{color:var(--text);}
.file-tree .best{color:var(--accent2);font-weight:600;}
.file-tree .comment{color:rgba(148,163,184,.5);font-style:italic;}

/* ─── FOOTER ──────────────────────────────────── */
.footer{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  text-align:center;padding:32px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;
  position:relative;z-index:1;
}
.footer a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;}
.footer-wave{
  width:100%;height:60px;background:var(--card);
  clip-path:ellipse(55% 100% at 50% 0%);margin-bottom:20px;
}

/* ─── RESPONSIVE ──────────────────────────────── */
@media(max-width:720px){
  .charts-grid,.toc-grid,.theory-grid,.summary-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .author-card{flex-direction:column;}
  .pipeline{flex-direction:column;}
  .pipe-arrow{transform:rotate(90deg);}
}

/* ─── SCROLL REVEAL ───────────────────────────── */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease;}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="particles"></canvas>
<span id="top"></span>

<!-- ══ ANIMATED BANNER ══════════════════════════════ -->
<div class="banner">
  <div class="blob blob1"></div>
  <div class="blob blob2"></div>
  <div class="blob blob3"></div>

  <div class="banner-icon">🏠</div>
  <h1 class="banner-title">Robust Regression Engine</h1>
  <p class="banner-sub">
    A production-grade ML pipeline for house price prediction using regularization,
    cross-validation, tree-based models &amp; SVR — built to beat overfitting.
  </p>

  <div class="badge-row">
    <span class="tech-badge tb-py">🐍 Python 3.11</span>
    <span class="tech-badge tb-pd">🐼 Pandas</span>
    <span class="tech-badge tb-sk">🤖 Scikit-Learn</span>
    <span class="tech-badge tb-np">🔢 NumPy</span>
    <span class="tech-badge tb-mp">📊 Matplotlib</span>
    <span class="tech-badge tb-sns">🌊 Seaborn</span>
    <span class="tech-badge tb-jup">📓 Jupyter</span>
  </div>

  <div class="stat-row">
    <div class="stat-pill">📦 <strong>3,800</strong> Properties</div>
    <div class="stat-pill">🔢 <strong>11</strong> Features</div>
    <div class="stat-pill">🏆 Best R² <strong>0.9274</strong></div>
    <div class="stat-pill">🌲 <strong>Random Forest</strong> Wins</div>
    <div class="stat-pill">🎯 Target <strong>house_price_inr</strong></div>
    <div class="stat-pill">✅ Status <strong>Completed</strong></div>
  </div>

  <div class="social-row">
    <a class="soc-btn soc-gh" href="https://github.com/Dhairyapatel1mc" target="_blank">

      @Dhairyapatel1mc
    </a>
    <a class="soc-btn soc-li" href="https://linkedin.com/in/ghost-patel" target="_blank">
      <svg height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M20.447 20.452h-3.554v-5.569c0-1.328-.027-3.037-1.852-3.037-1.853 0-2.136 1.445-2.136 2.939v5.667H9.351V9h3.414v1.561h.046c.477-.9 1.637-1.85 3.37-1.85 3.601 0 4.267 2.37 4.267 5.455v6.286zM5.337 7.433a2.062 2.062 0 01-2.063-2.065 2.064 2.064 0 112.063 2.065zm1.782 13.019H3.555V9h3.564v11.452zM22.225 0H1.771C.792 0 0 .774 0 1.729v20.542C0 23.227.792 24 1.771 24h20.451C23.2 24 24 23.227 24 22.271V1.729C24 .774 23.2 0 22.222 0h.003z"/></svg>
      ghost-patel

<!-- THEORY -->
<div class="section reveal" id="theory">
  <div class="section-label">🧠 Concepts</div>
  <div class="section-title">Theory Concepts</div>
  <div class="theory-grid">
    <div class="theory-card">
      <h4>🔒 Regularization</h4>
      <p>Adds a penalty term to the loss function to discourage model complexity. Prevents overfitting by shrinking coefficients toward zero. Essential when training error ≪ test error.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="theory-card">
      <h4>⚖️ Ridge (L2) vs Lasso (L1)</h4>
      <p>Ridge penalizes sum of <em>squared</em> coefficients — shrinks all but keeps all features. Lasso penalizes sum of <em>absolute</em> values — can zero out features (automatic feature selection).</p>
    </div>
    <div class="theory-card">
      <h4>🔁 Cross-Validation</h4>
      <p>Resampling technique to evaluate generalization. Splits data into k folds; each fold serves as validation once. Reduces overfitting to a single train/test split.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="theory-card">
      <h4>📅 Time Series Split</h4>
      <p>CV strategy respecting temporal ordering — training window always precedes validation window. Prevents data leakage in time-dependent datasets like sales data.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="theory-card">
      <h4>🌲 Why Trees Skip Scaling</h4>
      <p>Decision trees split on thresholds — only relative ordering of values matters. Whether area is 0–3000 or 0–1 doesn't change split quality. Unlike SVR/Ridge which are distance-sensitive.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="theory-card">
      <h4>📉 Bias–Variance Tradeoff</h4>
      <p>High bias = underfitting (model too simple). High variance = overfitting (model memorises noise). Best model minimises total error = bias² + variance + irreducible noise.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
/* ── PARTICLES ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const canvas=document.getElementById('particles'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
let W,H,pts=[];
function resize(){W=canvas.width=window.innerWidth;H=canvas.height=window.innerHeight;}
resize(); window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
for(let i=0;i<90;i++) pts.push({
  x:Math.random()*9999,y:Math.random()*9999,
  vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.4,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.4,
  r:Math.random()*2+.5,
  c:`hsla(${Math.random()*60+240},${60+Math.random()*30}%,${60+Math.random()*20}%,${.3+Math.random()*.4})`
});
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  pts.forEach(p=>{
    p.x=(p.x+p.vx+W)%W; p.y=(p.y+p.vy+H)%H;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.c;ctx.fill();
  });
  pts.forEach((a,i)=>pts.slice(i+1).forEach(b=>{
    const d=Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);
    if(d<120){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(167,139,250,${(1-d/120)*.12})`;ctx.lineWidth=.6;ctx.stroke();}
  }));
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
draw();

/* ── SCROLL REVEAL ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');}
}),{threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));

/* ── ANIMATED PERFORMANCE BARS ─────────────────────────────── */
function animateBars(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.perf-fill').forEach(el=>{
    const w=el.dataset.w;
    setTimeout(()=>{el.style.width=w+'%';},300);
  });
}
const barObs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting){animateBars();barObs.disconnect();}
}),{threshold:.3});
const perfSection=document.getElementById('perf');
if(perfSection) barObs.observe(perfSection);
</script>
